newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling flat against dlr but seen firming.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling flat against dlr but seen firming.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling was unchanged on the dollar but firmer against the pound amid inflows from the agricultural sector in lacklustre trading, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted an unchanged mean shilling average of 55.45 against the dollar and at 92.66 against the pound from 93.12.
"Inflows are pouring in from traditional importers, mainly coffee and tea. Demand is weak at the moment," a dealer said.
Another dealer said the shilling was expected to gain from tea and coffee exporters offloading dollars.
"The market is rather dead with very little interbank trading going on," one dealer said. "Very little business transacted from the importer section."
Philip Wambua, a dealer at Banque Indosuez, said most importers were on the sidelines and had adopted a wait-and-see attitude because they expected the shilling to strengthen.
Dealers said they expected some demand to come from the oil industry in December but expected the shilling to continue upwards against the dollar if trade remained at such a low ebb.
The money market was fairly liquid with a good number of banks lending. Rates dipped to between 15-20 percent from 22 percent levels on Monday.
